events.title: Ethereum currency on Hack Forums
events.description: Ethereum was added as a cryptocurrency on Hack Forums. The Ethereist award launched at $15 for the first 48 hours before rising to $20 USD; Ethereum can also be used as upgrade payment and may extend to sticky purchases depending on uptake.

events.title: Minimum $1 USD on non-free account sales
events.description: Giveaways of non-free accounts for pennies were closed off; Omniscient ruled each sold account must cost at least $1 USD.

events.title: Music Lover award
events.description: The Music Lover award was added (“For the lovers of music who have actual taste”). Requirements were still unclear; activity in Melody, Harmony, Rhythm, and MP3 was suggested.
